name: DocZest
description: DocZest is a fast, privacy-first, offline-first PDF and document toolkit for Android — scan, compress, merge, split, convert and share entirely on your device. No account, no document upload. Built for students, office workers, shopkeepers and anyone who needs everyday PDF tools without a heavyweight editor. Currently under construction — coming soon to Google Play.
features: Document scanner with crop and enhancement
Compress PDF to a target size
Document Ready presets (WhatsApp, Email, Print, Government Upload)
Local history, share sheet and system printing
Dark mode with selectable color themes

notes: App page preview published — under construction
Play Store and APK downloads coming soon
